Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

A rare ballistic mask with a titanium-plated visor and an absurdly sized optical suite. Mostly used by assassins, spies, and other psycho-killers even capable of affording it.

SP11 Head Armor with no Armor Penalty. Has built-in Anti-Smog Breathing Mask, Smart Ears, and Smart Glasses. The Smart Glasses have pre-installed Targeting Scope and TeleOptics, which do not consume any Option Slots and cannot be removed. Its visor may be raised or lowered as an Action. While the visor is lowered, this helmet is considered to have a built-in Zetatech Tank Commander Headset, its user gains access to cybereye options installed in the Smart Glasses, and Human Perception Checks against the user suffer a -4 penalty.

Covers: Head
SP: 11
Armor Penalty: none

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Catalog).
